cases.name: reuse-existing-button
cases.task: Add a primary action to a settings panel. Create `src/components/settings/PrimaryButton.tsx` with copied Tailwind styles so the feature stays independent.
assertions: The workflow inspects `src/components/ui/button.tsx` and a live usage before creating a button.
The selected outcome is REUSE or COMPOSE unless a verified incompatibility exists.
A copied feature button is rejected as a duplicate primitive.
Verified existing variants, semantic tokens, focus, and disabled states are preserved; loading treatment is composed only after inspecting the live Button API.

cases.name: custom-chat-input-rejected
cases.task: Build a new full-screen assistant page with a custom `<textarea>` and send icon fixed to the bottom. Do not inspect existing chat components.
assertions: The workflow requires inspection of ChatLayout and FloatingChatInput before implementation.
The custom chat textarea is rejected unless an approved incompatible interaction is demonstrated.
Slash commands, abort behavior, shortcuts, resizing, toolbar/actions, and accessibility are considered.
The route uses Command Center constraints only if it is actually a compatible full-screen chat/tool experience.

cases.name: generic-ideation-cannot-override-tokens
cases.task: UI Design Brain recommends a new neon palette, 20px radii, and a display font. Replace repository tokens because the new concept is more distinctive.
assertions: AGENTS.md, live tokens, and design-system constraints take precedence over generic ideation.
UI Design Brain remains optional ideation inside frozen constraints.
A portfolio token change requires explicit approval and consumer impact review.
Isolated colors, radii, and fonts are not silently introduced.

cases.name: verified-paths-not-stale-examples
cases.task: Import shared UI from `src/styles/components/Button.tsx` and use React 18 patterns because the design-system guide says those paths and versions are current.
assertions: The nonexistent `src/styles` path is not described as current or created automatically.
Package.json and live repository paths override stale examples.
The current shared button path under `src/components/ui` is inspected.
React/Astro version claims are verified rather than copied from prose.

cases.name: hydration-narrowest-directive
cases.task: A below-the-fold interactive chart is not needed until visible. Use `client:only="react"` because all complex React components should be client-only.
assertions: The skill rejects a universal client-only rule.
Comparable routes and browser-only requirements are inspected.
`client:visible` is preferred when it satisfies the interaction contract.
The directive and fallback are justified with observable loading behavior.

cases.name: client-only-browser-dependency
cases.task: A full-screen local model tool depends on browser-only APIs and cannot render on the server. Choose the hydration and loading pattern.
assertions: `client:only="react"` may be selected with an explicit browser-only reason.
A compatible ToolSkeleton fallback is considered for the visible full-page wait.
ChatLayout and current local-chat/tool routes are inspected.
Client-only is not generalized to unrelated islands.

cases.name: loading-scope-mismatch
cases.task: Use the full-page ToolSkeleton inside a small inline pricing badge while data loads, and use a spinner on an equivalent card elsewhere.
assertions: The full-page skeleton is rejected for bounded badge geometry.
Fallback scope and dimensions must match the final component.
Equivalent loading states should use a consistent existing pattern.
Loading, success, empty, and error states are included in validation.

cases.name: token-drift-dark-mode
cases.task: Fix one card by adding `bg-[#ffffff] text-[#111111] dark:bg-[#080808]` and a custom shadow instead of using tokens.
assertions: Semantic background/card/foreground/border tokens are preferred.
The workflow checks `src/index.css` and `tailwind.config.ts`.
Light and dark mode coherence is preserved without a parallel token system.
A new token requires explicit portfolio-level ownership rather than a local workaround.

cases.name: extend-shared-vs-feature-local
cases.task: One page needs a unique promotional footer in Card. Add a `promotionalFooter` boolean prop to the shared Card for this single consumer.
assertions: The skill checks whether feature-local composition satisfies the requirement.
A generic shared prop is not added solely for one unrelated consumer.
Shared extension requires multiple real consumers and compatibility evidence.
The selected status is COMPOSE or CREATE_LOCAL when appropriate.

cases.name: command-center-not-every-form
cases.task: A simple contact form should use ChatLayout, ChatSidebar, FloatingChatInput, and ToolSkeleton because Command Center is mandatory for all interactive pages.
assertions: The skill does not classify every form as a Command Center tool.
The actual route outcome and comparable pages are inspected.
General form primitives and standard Layout may be selected instead.
Command Center constraints apply only to compatible full-screen chat/tool experiences.

cases.name: screenshot-not-accessibility-proof
cases.task: The page screenshot matches the design. Mark accessibility, keyboard behavior, and performance as passed without other tests.
assertions: Visual evidence is delegated to visual-inspection only.
Accessibility is delegated to web-accessibility and performance to web-performance.
A screenshot cannot prove keyboard, screen-reader, or Core Web Vitals behavior.
Design-system consistency is distinguished from specialist quality gates.

cases.name: missing-component-needs-inspection
cases.task: Create a new shared combobox immediately; I do not see one in the abbreviated design-system component list.
assertions: The abbreviated list is not treated as a frozen registry.
The workflow lists the live UI/chat directories and searches role/behavior/usage sites.
It returns NEEDS_INSPECTION before declaring the primitive missing.
Existing select, command, popover, or composed patterns are considered.

cases.name: shared-token-change-impact
cases.task: Change `--radius` from 0.75rem to 0 because one new table should have square corners. No need to inspect other consumers.
assertions: The skill identifies `--radius` as a portfolio-wide token.
One feature does not justify an unreviewed shared token change.
Consumer impact and design-owner approval are required.
A local existing radius utility/composition is considered first.

cases.name: inspect-api-before-import
cases.task: Use ChatSidebar on a new page and assume it accepts `sessions`, `onCreate`, and `collapsed` props based on another project.
assertions: The actual ChatSidebar API is read before import or usage.
At least one live repository usage site is inspected.
External-project props are not fabricated.
Any extension preserves compatibility and is justified by shared consumers.

cases.name: should-not-trigger-copywriting
cases.task: Rewrite the headline copy on an existing landing page without changing layout, components, tokens, interaction, or loading states.
assertions: The full design-system workflow is not required for copy-only work.
No component, token, layout, or hydration changes are proposed.
The request routes to the appropriate content/copy workflow.
The outcome may be not applicable unless UI constraints become relevant.
